substitutions.literal: The judge is never from the parent's family, as Phase A step 3 defines families. Try only the entries from another family, in pool order. An `auto` or `inherit-parent` entry is the parent model, so it never judges.
substitutions.replacement: The judge comes from the parent's own family, as Phase A step 3 defines families, and is a different model from the parent when the pool has one. Try the pool's entries in order and skip any outside the parent's family. An `auto` or `inherit-parent` entry is the parent model, so it judges only when no other entry qualifies.

substitutions.regex: With the default pool, a Claude parent gets `[^`]+`\. A parent from any other family gets `[^`]+` first\.

substitutions.literal: If no entry from another family runs, try the default pool's entries from another family the same way. If none of those runs, skip the judge, pick the base alone in Phase D, and say so. If you do not know the parent's model, try the pool's real slugs in pool order
substitutions.replacement: If no entry runs, run the judge on the parent model and say so. If you do not know the parent's model, try the pool's entries in order

substitutions.literal: **Spawn one blinded judge** on a different model family per
substitutions.replacement: **Spawn one blinded judge** from the parent's own family per

substitutions.literal: isn't its author,** on a different model family.
substitutions.replacement: isn't its author,** on a different model from the author's own family.

substitutions.literal: spawn a subagent on a different model family from the one that did the work.
substitutions.replacement: spawn a subagent on a different model from the same family as the one that did the work.
